records.text: The expanded introduction previews seven sections: “It starts with you” examines personal strengths, weaknesses, and motivations; “What do I really stand for?” explores core values and beliefs and aligning actions and goals; “How deep are my roots?” explores identity and connection to culture, community, and heritage; “Resourcefulness” develops creativity, innovation, and problem-solving; “Acting proactively” covers initiative, goal-setting, persistence, and determination; “Practice what you preach” emphasizes aligning words and actions and leading by example; and “Intrinsic motivators” explores inner sources of motivation and fulfillment.

records.text: The proposed introduction says awakening the inner lion can foster self-awareness, confidence, purpose, and positive impact in readers’ personal and professional lives, communities, and the wider world. On 2023-05-26, the user asked for explanations of two FreeRADIUS `sites-available/default` configuration snippets involving the `ldap` section, LDAP group-name matching, reply attributes, and rejection behavior.

The first FreeRADIUS snippet runs its policy when `ok` is true and `&NAS-Port == 1`, sets `bsa`'s `fail` value to 9, then checks `ok` and whether `reply:Auth-Type == "Accept"`. It matches `reply:Ldap-Group-Name` against `^cn=.*,cn=(.*),ou=Client,dc=dev-ldap,dc=fnsmalaysia,dc=com$`; on a match it sets `Fortinet-Group-Name` to capture group 1 and copies the existing `Reply-Message`. A nonmatching group sets `Reply-Message` to `Unknown group name.` and rejects. If `Auth-Type` is not `Accept`, it copies the existing `Auth-Type` and `Reply-Message` into the reply and rejects. If the inner `ok` check fails, it runs `bsa_cancel` and rejects.

The second FreeRADIUS snippet checks `ok`, then matches `reply:Ldap-Group-Name` against `^cn=.*,cn=(.*),ou=Client,dc=dev-ldap,dc=fnsmalaysia,dc=com$`. On a match, it replaces `Ldap-Group-Name` with capture group 1 and copies the existing `Reply-Message`. If the subsequent `ok` check succeeds and `reply:Auth-Type == "Reject"`, it sets `Reply-Message` to `This is the reject after checking the group name`. Otherwise it copies the existing `Auth-Type` and `Reply-Message`, runs `bsa_cancel`, and rejects. If the group-name pattern does not match, it sets `Reply-Message` to `Unknown group name.` and rejects. If the `ok` check after the matching branch fails, it runs `bsa_cancel` and rejects.
